title: McpGetCitationOutput
description: Output of get_citation: one Citation whose text hash was recomputed from canonical text. A mismatch is integrity_error, never a returned citation. Every output carries evidence_context and coverage_note (design contract §7).

index_version_id.description: This tool does not use an index. It stays null even if an index is published or rebuilt.

verifier_version.description: Fixed v1 context marker for non-verification tools; never the active or latest verifier.

coverage_note.description: What was searched: issuers, forms and date range under the visibility predicate. An empty result reads 'no matching evidence in the visible indexed corpus', never a claim that a company did not disclose something (design contract §7).

from.description: Earliest visible public_at in scope, or null when nothing is visible.

to.description: Latest visible public_at in scope, never after effective_as_of; null when nothing is visible.
